pain: Homer needs accurate, privacy-preserving workflow-job evidence before admitting it into any Activity Event or performance Projection.
done_when: The pure mapper validates exact reviewed repository/job/run identity, source timestamps and canonical source URL; unverified sender, private steps and environment variables are not copied.
Queued, in_progress and completed states retain distinct semantics; missing run attempts or runner identities remain Unknown, not guessed.
Read-only enrichment refuses mismatched run, job, repository, runner, commit and attempt evidence and does not overwrite original webhook timestamps.
GitHub provider original actor and rerun triggering actor remain separate and never create Homer Actor Identity Bindings without evidence.
Synthetic tests cover spoofing, malformed observations, source conflicts, unknown Actors and immutable inputs; no live subscription or dispatch is enabled.
